description: GTGD mua NĐTNN per mã CK tại ngày t
etl_logic: SUM(securities_trade.execution_vol * securities_trade.execution_price) GROUP BY securities_trade.security_symbol_code, securities_trade.trade_dt WHERE securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date AND securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND securities_trade.buy_foreign_investor_tp_code IN ('10','20')

etl_logic: SUM(securities_trade.execution_vol * securities_trade.execution_price) GROUP BY securities_trade.security_symbol_code, securities_trade.trade_dt WHERE securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date AND securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND securities_trade.sell_foreign_investor_tp_code IN ('10','20')
